text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh, this sucks... I can't believe I lost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's what I get for trying to flex
in front
of everyone. I legit thought I had
it too. Welp.
Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry 'bout me. I'll get over
this real
quick and get right back to
work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wanna win the next one. Like... badly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wanna win the next one. Like... badly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, talk about reliable! I knew I could
trust you
to be there for me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
One-way streets aren't my thing, though,
so I just
wanna make sure... Do you
believe in me, too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, are you absolutely convinced with
100% of
your heart and soul that I'll be
able to win?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Good! Thanks for that! Heck yeah, My confidence is back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm so gonna win next time! Just you
watch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've worked so hard all this time because I wanna win! I've been wanting to win ever since you chose me as your trainee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, pause. Did I suddenly just get my
groove
back, just like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, you bamboozled me into
getting fired
up! You're such a cheater!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, but still, thanks. You wanna see
me put
my money where my mouth is?
All right, bet! I'll
show you what victory
looks like next time!
